page.overview:
Who is Fredhrick II?

Fredhrick II was the second Emperor of the House of Hajus Corrino. He and his sister Alia VII were the children of Fredhrick I al-Hajus and the Imperial Consort, Duchess Hippolute Atreides.

Fredhrick II and Alia VII ascended the throne as joint rulers after the death of Fredherick I in 7456 AG.

He and Alia VII were succeeded after her death in 7519 AG by her son (Fredherick II's nephew) Sidir XVIII.
